claims.evidence: Witness read model/brand from panel, consistent with known Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e being a color MFP, but no photo shows an actual color print/output sample or internal color engine.
No photo of the page/usage counter or service meter screen on the touchscreen.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: Internal parts (drum unit, toner cartridges) not visible in any photo; requires an open-panel shot.
No functional/power-on test or print sample shown; jam status can't be assessed from a static photo.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or function after outdoor storage on bare concrete (moisture/dust ingress)
risks.proof: Video of unit powering on, touchscreen booting, and a live test print/copy coming out

risks.risk: Actual page/usage counter could be far higher than claimed
risks.proof: Clear photo or screenshot of the meter/counter screen on the control panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as high page-count unit (worst case)

risks.risk: Drum/toner condition unverifiable; could be worn or empty despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Photos of drum unit and toner cartridges removed from the machine, showing install date or fill level

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (trays, cables, finisher, power cord)
risks.proof: Full-view photos of all sides, rear port area, and included accessories laid out
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Cosmetic/water damage to sides and rear not visible, given outdoor dirty storage
risks.proof: Photos of left, right, rear panels and underside/casters
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wear plus possible hidden damage

risks.risk: Plastic wrap bundle could be hiding a defect or missing part under packaging
risks.proof: Close-up photo with wrap removed showing the covered section
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming defect under wrap until shown clear

proof_requests: Video of the unit powering on and completing a live color test print/copy
Clear photo/screenshot of the page/usage counter on the touchscreen
Photos of drum unit and toner cartridges removed, showing condition/fill level
Photos of all external sides (left, right, rear) and underside/casters
Close-up photo with the plastic wrap removed
List/photo of included accessories, cables, and trays
response.reason: Identity is confirmed by the witness (Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e), but all seller performance/condition claims are unverifiable remotely and outdoor storage adds risk, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
